links.comparator_used: Original human-authored WeChat NHOT health education articles (unsimplified)
links.outcome: Understandability (C-PEMAT), content quality (C-DISCERN) and actionability of LLM-rewritten vs original texts
links.effect: All models significantly enhanced understandability of original texts (p < 0.01); Grok and Qwen also improved content quality and actionability. Rewriting performed more reliably than de novo generation.
links.tradeoff: Prompt optimization decreased lexical richness. All AI-generated materials still require clinical professional review before distribution.
links.quote: In the rewriting task (Prompt C), all models significantly enhanced the understandability of original texts (p < 0.01), with Grok and Qwen additionally improving content quality and actionability.

links.comparator_used: Baseline prompt (Prompt A) with no simplification instruction
links.outcome: C-DISCERN content quality, C-PEMAT understandability and actionability of generated texts
links.effect: Simplification prompt (Prompt B) significantly reduced C-DISCERN scores across all models (all p < 0.001) without meaningfully improving understandability or actionability.
links.tradeoff: Simplistic plain-language instructions risked compromising content quality; prompt optimization reduced lexical richness.
links.quote: The simplification prompt (Prompt B) significantly reduced C-DISCERN scores across all models (all p < 0.001) without meaningfully improving understandability or actionability.
